#### **Rituals**

At their lowest power rituals can be used to extend or make permanent spell effect, target specific creatures with a spell effect, summon creatures,  change weather locally etc.

At their highest level they can be used to kill foes from afar, bind peoples will, entrap, regional weather effects… sky is the limit.

#### **Size**

                 **Small**- extend a spell effect, effect limited to single 
                person/item

                 **Medium-** damage at a distance, local effect (quarter mile) 
                radius, bind creature, make permanent spell effect

		 **Large-** regional effect (up to 100 mile radius), kill at a 
		distance, suborn free will,  bind powerful creature, compel to answer

#### **Requirements**

                 **Earth-** needs to be tied to ritual target or effect.

                 **Air-** needs to be tied to ritual target or effect

                **Water** needs to be tied to ritual target or effect

              **Soul- Constitution points.**

			Use of personal constitution. Can pour points into ritual over time. 
			Constitution loss  Can be given over time. If use your own 
			constitution, can only be regained over time (1pt constitution per 
			month)

			Can use other sentient creatures, willing or unwilling.

			Small ritual will range between 5-20 points
			Medium between 21-100
			Large between 101 to ???

                **Specific Focus**- Something that represents/tied to ritual effect.

		 **Ritual Instructions**  these can be found or developed through 
		research


**At level 2**, casters have a base 5% chance of success. This increased 5% every 2 levels (max 50% at level 20).

#### **Size Modifier**

                Small= no penalty

                Medium= -25% penalty

                Large= -50% penalty

#### **Attribute Bonus Modifier**

10% per attribute bonus (e.g., +1 = 10%, +2= 20%, +3= 30%)

#### **Materials used**

                ##### **Line/circle drawing**

                                Mundane (e.g., salt, chalk, etc)
                                                Small= no bonus/penalty
                                                Medium= -10%
                                                Large= -20%

                                Copper  
                                                Small, cost 50gp= +10%
                                                Medium, cost 100gp= no bonus/penalty
                                                Large, cost 500pg = -10%

                                Silver
		                                Small, cost 100gp  = +20%
                                                Medium, cost 500gp  = +10%
                                                Large, cost 1000gp  = no bonus/penalty

				Gold
						Small, cost 500gp  = +30%
                                                Medium, cost 1000gp  = +20%
                                                Large, cost 5000gp  = +10%

                                Platinum
						Small, cost 5000gp  = +40%
                                                Medium, cost 10000gp  = +30%
                                                Large, cost 50000gp  = +20%

                ##### **Gem piles (5 at each intersection line) – gems are consumed during ritual**

                                5 gems, cost 250g (50gp/each)= no bonus/penalty
				5 gems, cost 500g (100gp/each)= +5%
				5 gems, cost 1000g (200gp/each)= +10%
				5 gems, cost 2500g (500gp/each)= +15%
				5 gems, cost 5000g (1000gp/each)= +20%

                **##### Constitution is consumed during ritual**
				Offer up minimum amount= no penalty
				Offer >10% = 10% bonus
				Offer >20% = 20% bonus
				Offer >30% = 30% bonus


### **There is always at least a 1% chance to fail**
